summary: Iter95: verified the CV identity-safety architecture around premium report d8c04d5d-6618-4db2-a128-865447478ef6 (and the 2 other seeded reports). All 10 backend pytest tests pass. Admin login works, buyer /api/reports/{id} contains full_report + video_comments with frame_url + >=2 tele_clip_url and NO 'cv_shadow' key anywhere in the payload (deep-scanned). Evidence frame returns 200 image/jpeg, tele_clip returns 200 video/mp4. Admin /api/admin/cv-shadow/summary aggregate={reports:3, checked:295, suspect_rate<=0.05, switch_risk_frames:0, gap_bridge_active:true, engine_version:5}, and /api/admin/reports/{id}/cv-shadow returns engine_version=5. Both admin endpoints correctly require auth (403 without token). Frontend: admin can log in and reach /admin, Reports tab shows the cv-shadow-stats-toggle panel; expanding it renders cv-shadow-agg ("3 reports · 295 track checks · identity match 0.581 · suspect 1% · switch-risk 0 · gap bridging ACTIVE") plus cv-gap-bridge-status. The Radar button admin-cv-shadow-d8c04d5d-... opens cv-shadow-dialog with cv-shadow-stats (track checks 135, id-match 0.551, suspect 1(1%), switch-risk 0, empty-box 5, crowded 63, tap self-verify 0.818) and a cv-shadow-gallery with 3 flagged-moment thumbs (empty·01:08, empty·01:12, suspect·01:08). VISUAL CHECK PASSED: raw evidence frames (frame_00.jpg and frame_02.jpg) show a green grounded ellipse under the tracked player's feet, rendered BEHIND the boots/legs (occlusion working), and contain NO player-name label, NO 'TRACKED' text, NO chip/pill/pointer overlay. 'TRACKED' string is absent from the buyer report page body. Homepage loads (200). No cost-triggering endpoints were called.

ui_bugs.issue: On initial dialog open, the 3 flagged-moment thumbnails inside cv-shadow-gallery remained in spinner/skeleton state during the ~3s wait window — the children were 0 at the time of inspection. Blob-fetch may be slow or missing final assignment. Non-blocking; needs a longer wait to confirm they eventually resolve.

integration_issues.flow: Admin dashboard reports tab / cv-shadow expand
integration_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' (React key duplication) fires when the CV Shadow panel expands. Cosmetic — likely duplicate report_id used as key across two lists in CvShadowStats/reports table.
Multiple 404 resource errors in console (6+). Origin not identified in this pass; may be missing static assets/icons. Non-blocking.

action_items: Investigate React duplicate-key warning triggered by CV Shadow reports list (CvShadowStats.jsx) — use a composite key (report_id + index) if report_id can repeat.
Check the source of the ~6 404 console errors on /admin (likely missing image/icon assets).
Verify cv-shadow-gallery thumbnails resolve within a reasonable time on dialog open; consider a loaded/error state visible on the thumbs after N seconds.
critical_code_review_comments: Buyer serialization is properly whitelist-based — full deep scan of the report JSON confirmed 'cv_shadow' string absent for all 3 seeded premium reports. Good.
Admin cv-shadow endpoints correctly 403 unauthenticated requests.
Signed tele_clip_url (?tk=&exp=) works without Authorization header — good separation of buyer media auth from admin bearer.
Phase-15 marker rendering verified visually across two independent frames: grounded ellipse anchored at foot/ground-contact and correctly occluded by the player silhouette.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (functional; minor console warnings/404s + one thumbnail loading concern)

seed_data_creation: None — all verification used existing reports (d8c04d5d..., fe7bc3e5..., 3467a622...). No mutations, uploads, regenerate-evidence, or shadow-run triggers were called.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iter95_cv_shadow.py (10 tests, all passing). Buyer report /api/reports/{id} response shape has video_comments at top level (not nested under full_report). Admin /api/admin/cv-shadow/summary returns {aggregate:{...}, reports:[...]}, and /api/admin/reports/{id}/cv-shadow returns {report_id, cv_shadow:{engine_version,...}}. Frontend testids confirmed working: cv-shadow-stats-toggle, cv-shadow-agg, cv-gap-bridge-status, admin-cv-shadow-{reportId}, cv-shadow-dialog, cv-shadow-stats, cv-shadow-gallery.
